name: Legends Temporal
summary: Operate any local, self-hosted, or Temporal Cloud cluster with durable cron and interval schedules, one-shot start_delay timers, zero-rewrite 11-field ScriptJob and AgentJob workers across split control and exec task queues, compact event-history failure diagnosis, a confirm-gated stdio MCP server, and a 6-note Empire knowledge pack.
outcomes: Audit offline SDK and knowledge-pack readiness or run live gRPC, namespace, task-queue poller, Web UI HTTP, and SSH systemd unit health checks via legends-temporal doctor --live
Create, preview (--dry-run), apply, trigger, pause, unpause, backfill, and delete durable server-side cron and interval schedules from CLI flags, JSON/YAML files, or existing Python job inventories
Fire one-shot durable delayed timers (30s, 15m, 2h, 3d, 1h30m) built on Temporal start_delay to run scripts, inline Python, arbitrary argv commands, env-held webhooks, or agent session turns
Run split control-plane and exec-plane workers hosting the replay-safe 11-field ScriptJob workflow so existing scripts execute unchanged on the machine that owns the data
List, filter, start, signal, query, cancel, and terminate workflow executions and reduce raw protobuf event histories into compact failure verdicts via workflow history --diagnose
Serve read-only inspection tools plus a confirm-gated timer tool over stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 (legends-temporal mcp) and resolve the 6-note Temporal knowledge pack for legends-empire
examples: Check if our Temporal server, namespace, and control and exec task-queue pollers are healthy
Preview and create a nightly 02:30 cron schedule or apply a JSON schedule inventory with overlap and catchup policies
Schedule a one-shot durable timer in 15 minutes to run a Python script, POST an env-held webhook, or wake an agent session
List failed workflows from last night and run workflow history --diagnose to get the script exit code, worker identity, output tail, and remediation hint
Start a control-plane or exec-plane ScriptJob worker and resolve the 6-note Temporal knowledge pack paths
exclusions: Never stores API keys, webhook URLs, or notification private keys in Temporal workflow inputs, history payloads, or config show outputs
Never deletes schedules or terminates running workflows without an explicit --yes confirmation flag
Never executes mutations from the stdio MCP server except temporal_timer_schedule when confirm: true is explicitly supplied
